objective: Build credible ERN traffic and visitor-utility evidence so traffic-gated Travelpayouts programs can be rechecked later without guessing their private unlock thresholds.

gatedPriority.why: Largest strategic fit because it can cover stays plus other travel needs.
Useful activity breadth if ERN later needs a second/third activities source.
Potential car-rental depth after visitor traffic is larger.

evidenceToAccumulate: organic search/AI discovery evidence where available
first eligible affiliate transaction when it eventually occurs
recheckTriggers: Travelpayouts visibly changes a program from unavailable/locked to link-generation available
ERN traffic is materially higher than the owner-observed baseline
ERN demonstrates sustained visitor use rather than internal testing
a gated program becomes necessary to fill a real visitor need that accessible programs cannot serve
doNotDo: Do not repeatedly apply or click around gated programs.
Do not open duplicate direct affiliate accounts merely because Travelpayouts is locked.
Do not claim a program is unlocked from its catalog card alone.
Do not alter ERN editorial ranking to chase program access.
